name: Emergency Flush Activation Guard
description: When the chlorine concentration exceeds the safety threshold (b_over_cl=1), an emergency flush is activated to dilute the water and reduce chlorine. Guarded UPR: flush applies only when b_over_cl=1.

elements.name: Chlorine Over-Threshold Flag
elements.description: Binary flag: 0=chlorine within WHO limit, 1=chlorine exceeds safety threshold.

uncertainty.source: SWaT PLC2 chlorine safety interlock: AIT202 > 1.0 mg/L triggers flush

elements.name: Maximum Post-Flush Chlorine
elements.description: Post-flush maximum: 30s dilution must reduce concentration below 0.8 mg/L

consistency_relations.upr_sigma: σ(C) = C×exp(-k×t_flush) if b_over_cl=1, else C — guard activates dilution decay when over-threshold flag set
consistency_relations.upr_description: Guarded UPR: emergency flush dilution formula applies only when chlorine over-threshold flag b_over_cl=1.
